title: Vampire Vape Vlads VG Black Ice Breaking Point 10ml
description: Black Ice Breaking Point from Vampire Vape’s Vlads collection delivers a rush of nostalgic sweetshop flavour from your very first vape. If you loved the iconic Blackjack sweets then you’ll love Black Ice Breaking Point, with authentic notes of spicy aniseed, enveloping sweet sugar hard candy, and lifted to an icy finish with cool Menthol on the exhale. Vampire Vapes’ new Vlads VG collection assembles some of the most iconic e-liquid flavours to come out of the legendary vape makers labs, and makes them available in high-VG, 10ml bottles. The collection includes such famous flavours as Heisenberg and Pinkman, as well as newer additions like Blue Gun, Loser and Attraction Fatal. Vampire Vapes’ Vlads VG e-liquids contain a 70VG/30PG ratio that makes them ideal for use in vape kits that use sub-ohm coils, as well as being easy to travel with. These kits include advanced vape kits as well as pod kits and refillable pods that use coils with a resistance of 0.8ohm or lower. Their High-VG content provides a deeply flavoursome experience with a smooth, comfortable throat hit and clouds of satisfying vaper! Based in Manchester, England Vampire Vape are one of the most popular and influential e-liquid brands in the UK. The company has won international renown for the quality and variety of their e-liquids, and for their signature flavours including such game-changing e-liquid icons as Heisenberg and Pinkman flavours.
